reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, dayFromDate and captureBreadcrumb, but writes the weekend decision (skip for daily, move otherwise) a third time instead of sharing it with getUpcomingDates and getNextDate.

duplication.why: The skipWeekend / daily-skip / move-by-solve-mode branch repeats the same decision already written in getUpcomingDates (same file) and getNextDate (shared/schedules.ts), and the try/captureBreadcrumb wrapper is copied from getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in schedules/app.ts and is registered like it; the per-occurrence weekend rule would belong better in shared/schedules.ts beside getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

scope.why: Only adds the handler, its registration and a test.

maintainability.why: Three copies of the weekend rule (and one defaults weekendSolveMode to 'after' while the others do not) will drift the next time weekend handling changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared per-occurrence weekend function exists to bypass; the change calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend and the RSchedule helpers directly.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange in schedules/app.ts rewrites getUpcomingDates' weekend branches as a per-occurrence loop with continue statements and a Set, the same decision in a different shape.
